contents.sampling_resolution: The original fixed-size reservoir identities were not retained and DuckDB reservoir sampling was not identity-reproducible with preserve_insertion_order=false. Keep the original cohort, split, eligible counts, sample sizes, probabilities and weights, but freeze a new deterministic company-number hash sample before fitting. Record only its train/test hashes.

pairing.archive_timing_note: Accounts registration-month availability is distinct from monthly ZIP publication/download time; this does not claim the ZIP existed at month-end.
pairing.rule: Register is dated the first day of T+1; PSC is the latest available snapshot on or before that date; accounts rows were available in registration month <= T.
